mapper.insert: INSERT INTO body_record (user_id, date, weight, bodyCondition, skeletal_muscle, body_fat, img, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{weight}, #{bodyCondition}, #{skeletalMuscle}, #{bodyFat}, #{img}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE body_record SET weight = #{weight}, skeletal_muscle = #{skeletalMuscle}, body_fat = #{bodyFat}, img = #{img} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date}
mapper.select: SELECT date, DAYOFYEAR(date) -1 AS day, weight, skeletal_muscle, body_fat FROM body_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY date
